title: Brailee
text:
Posted August 13


Write about a time something did not go the way you expected.

Five paragraphs, roughly 600 to 800 words
Open with the moment itself, not with background
Tell me what you expected, what happened, and what you took from it
Read it out loud once before you turn it in

Due Friday. Turn it in as a shared doc.
